target.title: fix(plugins): remove incorrect modifying hook timeout fallback in getClaimingHookTimeoutMs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`getClaimingHookTimeoutMs` in `src/plugins/hooks.ts:499-504` is a copy-paste of `getModifyingHookTimeoutMs` but incorrectly kept the `modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook` dictionary as its fallback. Since no claiming-specific timeout dictionary exists, claiming hooks silently inherit timeouts intended for modifying hooks. A claiming hook using `before_agent_reply` would inherit the 3000ms modifying timeout instead of having no timeout.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix removes the erroneous fallback to `modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook`. Only `hook.timeoutMs` (the per-registration timeout) is used for claiming hooks.

## User Impact

- Before: Claiming hooks could inherit timeouts from modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook entries (e.g. before_agent_reply=3000ms)
- After: Claiming hooks only use their own hook.timeoutMs if explicitly set
- Modifying hooks are completely unaffected

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior addressed:** getClaimingHookTimeoutMs uses modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook as fallback, causing claiming hooks to inherit modifying timeouts
- **Real environment tested:** Linux x86_64, Node 24, commit `0da592392` on branch `fix/claiming-hook-timeout-dictionary` (rebased on upstream/main `94e1cc9a4`)
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:** `node --import tsx /tmp/verify-hook-runner-invoke.mjs` — real OpenClaw `createHookRunner` runtime invocation: creates a mock registry with a `before_agent_reply` claiming hook that delays 500ms (no explicit timeoutMs), then calls `runner.runBeforeAgentReply()` with `modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook.before_agent_reply=50ms`. On buggy code the claiming hook would inherit the 50ms modifying timeout and abort early; on fixed code the hook runs to completion (~500ms).
- **Evidence after fix:** Terminal capture of `node` runtime verification (copied live output):

  ```text
  Real OpenClaw createHookRunner runtime test for Bug 3:

  Test scenario: claiming hook (before_agent_reply) delays 500ms
  modifyingHookTimeoutMsByHook.before_agent_reply = 50ms (would affect claiming on buggy code)

  Result: undefined
  Elapsed: 501ms

  [PASS] Claiming hook completed (~500ms) - no incorrect modifying timeout applied

  Verdict: PASS (real createHookRunner invocation, hook ran to completion)
  ```

- **Observed result after fix:** Claiming hook completed in 501ms (full 500ms delay), proving no incorrect modifying timeout was inherited. On buggy code, the hook would have timed out at ~50ms.
- **What was not tested:** Other claiming hook entry points (inbound_claim); same fix applies symmetrically

## Tests and validation

```text
$ pnpm test src/plugins/hooks.phase-hooks.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       3 passed (3)
```

No type signature changes. Existing hooks tests pass.

## Risk checklist

- User-visible behavior: No — latent bug with no known triggering scenario
- Config/env/migration behavior: No
- Security/auth/secrets/network/tool execution: No
- Plugins/providers/channels/SDK: Yes — affects claiming hook timeout behavior; only removes incorrect fallback
- Highest-risk area: Claiming hooks that previously relied on the incorrect fallback
- Mitigation: Real `createHookRunner` invocation verifies claiming hook runs to completion without incorrect timeout; existing hooks tests pass

Closes: N/A (no existing issue)
